_doc: Reply radar: big X accounts worth a timely reply. The radar checks them only while the account owner is awake, at most one alert per account per day, 10–20 a day in all. Handles verified against TwitterAPI.io on 2026-10-03.

sweep._doc: Live radar (sweep.ts, every 15 min). A new post is weighed once it is recheckAfterMinutes old and dropped after giveUpAfterMinutes. It alerts if heat (weighted engagement per 1k followers, per hour, age floored at 1h) reaches minHeat and it has minLikes. Starting values; tune after the first days.

skipTopics._doc: Posts matching this pattern (case-insensitive) are dropped before drafting: politicians, parties, elections, wars. A numbers reply under them invites mutes and blocks, which cost reach. This also drops bitcoin news that names a politician ("Trump signs…"); remove a name to allow it.

holders.angle: How much of Manhattan, or how much gold, their stack buys

etf.angle: BlackRock's ETF coins in gold or Manhattan; flows in physical terms

voices.angle: Gold cube, Moon stack or sats grid, matched to the post

media.angle: Any comparison that fits the post

gold-macro.angle: We weigh both ways: the Dec 2024 peak vs today, Fort Knox share, 2013 vs now

news.angle: Price milestones (Moon stack %), Strategy buys, ETF news; only posts taking off
